lines.text: The LORD says He will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon and send strangers to winnow her.
The LORD calls people to flee Babylon, which was a silver cup in His hand that made the whole earth drunk.
The LORD has aroused the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because His plan is aimed at destroying Babylon.
The LORD of Hosts swears to fill Babylon with men as with locusts, and he made the earth by His strength.
The LORD will repay Babylon for the evil done in Zion and make the destroying mountain desolate forever.
